purpose: Measured ECG and measured noise for ecg-cleanup-under-morphology-constraints: real cardiac morphology plus real baseline wander and electrode-motion interference to remove under delay/ringing/morphology acceptance criteria.
format_note: raw/*.dat are PhysioNet format 212 (two 12-bit channels in 3 bytes); decode_212.py in this directory converts them deterministically. Gains/zeros come from the .hea headers (mitdb: 200 ADU/mV, zero 1024).

raw.content: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia record 100: 30 min, 2 ch (MLII, V5), mostly normal sinus rhythm; the canonical clean record. .atr carries beat annotations for timing acceptance checks.
MIT-BIH record 105: noisier record with visible artifact; useful when a harder cleanup target is wanted.
MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test DB 'bw': measured baseline-wander noise (two channels), physically recorded, not synthetic.
Noise Stress Test DB 'em': measured electrode-motion artifact, the hardest realistic interference class.

derived.content: First 60 s of record 100 in mV (t_s, MLII, V5); 21600 rows.
First 60 s of record 105 in mV.
First 60 s of measured baseline wander in mV.
First 60 s of measured electrode motion in mV.

usage_note: The lesson can mix record 100 with scaled bw/em noise at declared SNRs for a controlled before/after study, and add a synthetic 60 Hz mains line at declared amplitude (mitdb was recorded in a 60 Hz mains environment but line interference in record 100 is weak). Beat annotations (.atr) provide QRS timing ground truth; annotation decoding is not included here and should be added if timing metrics are computed programmatically.
